params.caption: 🎮 The Blood of Dawnwalker gets New Game+ and a level 100 cap next week Rebel Wolves, the studio founded by ex-CD Projekt Red developers, says update 1.2 lands next week with New Game+. The level cap rises to 100 with enemies scaled to match, and items get NG+ versions with new stats. The patch also rebalances enemy health and abilities and smooths out traversal. 🕒 Nov 13, 2026 · 20:12 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: GamesRadar+ 🧛 React if you're going back to Vale Sangora · 💬 Did you finish it yet? #BloodOfDawnwalker #RebelWolves #RPG #GamingNews 🔔 @LevelUpGames0
